zh.name: 「黑斗篷魔王」
zh.desc: 盘踞在银河深处的恐怖大魔王，拥有脚踩星系拳打黑洞的实力，数百万颗星球被笼罩在漆黑斗篷的阴影下，全银河都在呼唤一位能掀翻魔王统治的勇士。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成物理属性伤害。
对我方全体目标造成物理属性伤害，被击中目标降低生命值的一部分转化为<u>【侵蚀】</u>。

240320101.name: 侵蚀
240320101.desc: 攻击后回复侵蚀部分的生命值，击中的目标数量越多，回复的生命值越高。受到伤害时，降低生命值的一部分转化为侵蚀。消耗生命值时，降低的生命值会全部转化为侵蚀。通过回复生命值的方式解除侵蚀时，使自身获得【焕新】效果。【焕新】：下次攻击造成的伤害提高。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使【魔王爪牙】进入【共祭】状态，在数次行动内施放【幽冥的悼念】。
与【魔王爪牙】一同施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】，随后吸收【魔王爪牙】治疗自身，并获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>并进入【沉默的悲叹】状态，下次行动时施放【莫因舍弃而哭泣】。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 消耗所有<u>【灾难之力】</u>对我方全体造成数次少量物理属性伤害，消耗的【灾难之力】层数越多，伤害的段数越多，随后对我方全体造成少量物理属性伤害。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成物理属性伤害，消耗所有<u>【灾难之力】</u>额外造成数次少量物理属性伤害，消耗的【灾难之力】层数越多，伤害的段数越多。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】时，消耗生命值召唤【魔王爪牙】，并使消耗的生命值转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>。若该攻击召唤的【魔王爪牙】被消灭，则额外对自身造成物理属性伤害。当自身再次施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】时，曾被该攻击召唤的【魔王爪牙】将一同发起攻击，随后被自身吸收， 回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值并使自身获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>。

70000215.name: 苦痛缠绕
70000215.desc: 吸收【魔王爪牙】后回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值，【魔王爪牙】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 施放【沉默的悲叹】时，消耗生命值召唤【魔王爪牙】，并使消耗的生命值转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>。当拥有的<u>【灾难之力】</u>层数不为0时，若【魔王爪牙】受到致命攻击，则立即消耗1层<u>【灾难之力】</u>和一定比例的生命值，重新召唤【魔王爪牙】。施放【莫因舍弃而哭泣】时，吸收【魔王爪牙】并回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值。

70000215.name: 苦痛缠绕
70000215.desc: 吸收【魔王爪牙】后回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值，【魔王爪牙】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 获得一定层数的【减伤】，使自身受到的伤害降低，每有1个【魔王爪牙】被消灭后失去1层。

70000215.name: 苦痛缠绕
70000215.desc: 吸收【魔王爪牙】后回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值，【魔王爪牙】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【魔王爪牙】时消耗的生命值。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 展开无敌的黑斗篷，使自身和【魔王爪牙】受到的所有伤害降低为1。

en.name: "Black Cloak Demon King"
en.desc: A horrifying Demon King that resides in the depths of the cosmos, with the power to stomp on the galaxy and punch through black holes. Millions of planets have been shrouded under his black cloak, and the entire cosmos pleads for a hero who can overthrow the Demon King's reign.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.
Deals Physical DMG to all targets. Converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

240320101.name: Corrosion
240320101.desc: After attacking, restore a portion of Corroded HP. The more targets are hit, the more HP is restored. When taking DMG, a portion of the HP reduced is converted to Corrosion. When HP is consumed, the reduced HP will all be converted to Corrosion. When Corrosion is dispelled via restorative means, this unit obtains "Renewal." "Renewal" increases the DMG dealt by the next attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Causes "Demon King's Minions" to enter the "Mutual Sacrifice" state. Uses "Underworld's Grief" within a certain number of turns.
Uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" together with "Demon King's Minions." Then, absorbs "Demon King's Minions" to heal this unit while obtaining "<u>Calamity Power</u>."

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Obtains <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and enters the "Silent Sorrow" state. Uses "Cry Not for the Discarded" in the next action.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and deals several instances of minor Physical DMG hits to all targets, where the more consumed "Calamity Power" stacks, the higher the instances of DMG. Then, deals minor Physical DMG to all targets.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to additionally deal several instances of minor Physical DMG. The more consumed "Calamity Power" stacks, the higher the instances of DMG.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: When using "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate," consumes HP to summon "Demon King's Minions" and convert the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> If the "Demon King's Minions" summoned by this attack is defeated, additionally deals Physical DMG to this unit. When this unit uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again, the "Demon King's Minions" that were summoned by the attacking ability will attack together with this unit. This unit will then absorb the Minions, restoring the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony"</u> and granting <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to this unit.

70000215.name: Entangled By Agony
70000215.desc: After absorbing "Demon King's Minions," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Demon King's Minions." After "Demon King's Minions" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Demon King's Minions" again.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: When using "Silent Sorrow," consumes HP to summon "Demon King's Minions" and converts the consumed HP into "<u>Entangled By Agony</u>." When stacks of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> are not at 0 and if a "Demon King's Minion" receives a killing blow, immediately consumes 1 stack of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and a percentage of HP to resummon a "Demon King's Minion." When using "Cry Not for the Discarded," absorbs any "Demon King's Minion" and restores the HP that was converted to "<u>Entangled By Agony</u>."

70000215.name: Entangled By Agony
70000215.desc: After absorbing "Demon King's Minions," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Demon King's Minions." After "Demon King's Minions" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Demon King's Minions" again.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Receives a certain number of stacks of "DMG reduction," reducing DMG received by this unit. 1 stack is lost after defeating 1 "Demon King's Minion."

70000215.name: Entangled By Agony
70000215.desc: After absorbing "Demon King's Minions," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Demon King's Minions." After "Demon King's Minions" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Demon King's Minions" again.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Expands an invincible black cloak that reduces all DMG received by this unit and "Demon King's Minions" to 1.
